head: The Black Parade tops indie stores
line: A 2006 album was the top seller at US independent record stores in the last week of October.
Copies of The Black Parade sold at US indie stores that week. 6,391 of them were bought in person.
Physical albums sold at US indie stores that week, up 2.9% from the same week last year.

head: Still marching in
line: Almost every indie-store copy of that No. 1 went out over a counter, not through a website.

head: "Is this the original pressing?"
line: It's shrink-wrapped and has a barcode. No.
